title: ClearHead Transaction Result
description: The single receipt a transaction emits: a committed batch, a dry-run preview, or a typed rejection that wrote nothing. Discriminated on `kind`. Per-operation outcomes reuse the same VerbOutcome shapes the single mutation verbs already emit, and a rejection reuses the VerbError taxonomy, so the read side, the single verbs, and the batch surface all speak one spelling. Compare-and-swap / conflict outcomes are intentionally not modeled in v1 (no stale-update token exists yet).

verbOutcome.description: One applied (or, in a dry-run, would-be-applied) operation outcome. Mirrors clearhead-cli VerbOutcome: `children` is the cascade fan-out count for complete/cancel; `updated` carries no children.

children.description: Number of descendant actions also closed by this operation. Present for completed/cancelled.

operationOutcomes.description: One outcome per request operation, in request order.

files.description: Absolute paths of the .actions files written (committed) or that would be written (dry-run). Derived sidecars are not listed.

committed.description: The batch validated and committed through one PendingBatch.

dryRun.description: The batch validated but was not staged; nothing was written. Reports what would happen.

rejected.description: An operation failed to resolve or apply; the entire batch was rejected before any write. `operation` is the 0-based index of the offending request operation.

operation.description: 0-based index into the request `operations` array of the operation that failed.

verbError.description: Typed failure, mirroring clearhead-cli VerbError. Resolved under the workspace lock against trusted state.
